pr.body:
Approach: retry_budget.py validates every argument up front (built-in int only, minimum bounds) and raises ValueError. Then: attempt limit returns None; backoff is min(cap, base*2**(attempt-1)) via _backoff, which shortcuts zero base/cap and saturates once the shift reaches cap.bit_length() so no huge power is built; Retry-After is max() floor not capped by cap; returns None when elapsed+delay >= budget.

Files: retry_budget.py, test_retry_budget.py.

Checks: unittest before 3 errors (NotImplementedError); after 29/29 OK under -W error; py_compile OK. Review: one reviewer, pass, no findings.

Assumptions: invalid input raises ValueError per SPEC; stdlib only.
